edit.description: add maxParallel?: number to Chain.supervisorPolicy, beside quarantineScope/abortThreshold
runFanout/partition resolve maxParallel from chain.supervisorPolicy.maxParallel ?? DispatcherOptions.maxParallel ?? 4
forward the resolved value the same way quarantineScope/abortThreshold already are
cover the override and the byte-identical default

summary: maxParallel is programmatic-only (DispatcherOptions) with no chain declaration, unlike its supervisorPolicy siblings quarantineScope and abortThreshold.

per.section: Supervisor policy is a chain-overridable default

tests: a chain declaring supervisorPolicy.maxParallel overrides the DispatcherOptions default of 4
a chain declaring nothing gets maxParallel: 4 byte-identically to today
acceptance: maxParallel is a chain-overridable default alongside quarantineScope/abortThreshold, per engine-boundary.md's policy-constant rule.
notes: inbox 2026-08-03. No new validation added: spec/pending.md's Fanout partition section already documents a non-positive maxParallel degrading to width-1 batches rather than wedging — only the missing chain-declaration surface is the defect.

edit.description: harvestFriction stamps its destination filename so a retried entry's same-named source file can't silently overwrite an earlier still-unread note; correct the JSDoc's collision-freedom claim to match

summary: harvestFriction composes its destination with no exists-check; rename/copyFile silently replace an existing file, so a retry can destroy an earlier, still-unread friction note.
tests: two harvests for the same tag with the same agent-chosen source filename land as two distinct files, neither overwriting the other
acceptance: harvestFriction's destination naming is collision-free the way writeRevertNote's already is; its JSDoc no longer claims a guarantee the code didn't deliver.
notes: equilibrium audit, friction harvest + retired vocabulary cluster.
